rows.text: Of course we can, tick-tock! Clockie would tell his friends anything, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Dreamville, tick-tock! A beautiful and peaceful village, tick-tock! My friends and I live happy and carefree lives together here, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: However... The evil Boss Stone covets the stones that we used to build our town. That villain even claims that he is the town master's successor and wants to force us all out of here, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: But don't you worry, my friend! My friends and I will never let his evil plan succeed, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: All of my friends are endlessly fascinating...
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Brother Hanu is my most reliable companion. I can always relax with him watching my back, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Professor Owl and the origami birds... they created this town and they care for it like they would their own nests, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Then there is Miss Note, Mirror Princess, Old Man Wood, Hamster Ball Knight... Trust me, my friend! I know you'll love them all just like I do, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Remember, my dear friend! Clockie is here to serve you anytime!
rows.speaker: Clockie
